The applicable TECH-02/05 publication and operation-recovery rules must cover failed/interrupted universe creation before it is accepted. These are unresolved technical prerequisites, not implicit decisions or completed work.
stories.universeProfileDecision: DEC-12 resolved: inventory complete; required name, optional free-text description, existing approved universe capabilities and faction extensions; no separate world/city profiles added.

stories.dependencies: Approved Stories 1.1 and 1.2 only. Inherit the applicable TECH-01/02/04/05/11/12 prerequisites for identity, storage publication, operation recovery, writer coordination and native packaging. DEC-12 remains open for universe information; this story does not add universe profile fields. No project metadata fields beyond the agreed identity/association/storage needs are silently specified.

stories.title: Build and save a universe's repeating fictional calendar
stories.requirements: CAP-4; FR-8–13 and initial configuration support for FR-7; AD-3/6/8/10 and chronology convention; NFR-1/2/3/6/9.
stories.dependencies: Approved Stories 1.1–1.5 only; no future event or chapter story is required to build/use this calendar configuration. Resolve DEC-03 (elapsed coordinate/epoch/year bounds), DEC-04 (standalone-day/year-name display) and DEC-13 (builder validation) before their affected implementation. Inherit applicable TECH-01/02/04/05/11 storage/write gates; capture the builder interactions under PLAN-04. None of these unresolved details is decided by scope approval.
stories.minimumYearDecision: Year number and day count suffice; no months/names/explicit standalone-day entries required in days-only mode; optional empty list is not zero length.
stories.calendarValidationDecision: DEC-13 resolved: positive whole day/month/target counts, integer year, clear missing/fraction/nonnumeric errors; optional months/names; mismatch still saveable.
stories.yearNumberingDecision: DEC-03 resolved: no fixed upper/lower year bounds, arbitrary-precision exact integers, negative/zero/positive continuous order, no artificial epoch.
stories.standaloneDateDisplay: DEC-04 resolved: yearname/dayname-dayOfYear/yearnumber; omit absent year segment; omit absent dayname/hyphen; no empty segments. Exact signed unbounded year preserved.

stories.title: Record standalone events on the universe timeline
stories.requirements: CAP-3; FR-35, standalone-event application of FR-40 and timeline/event sharing under FR-44; optional-order entry support for FR-41. AD-3/6/8/10/18 and canonical event-ownership/chronology conventions; NFR-1/2/3/6/7/9.
stories.dependencies: Approved Stories 1.1–1.6 only. Direct universe operation does not require a project, although project entry uses the already approved association workflow. Inherit applicable TECH-01/02/04/05/11 identity/storage/publication/writer gates and DEC-03/04 chronology/display contracts. Capture timeline/event-entry interactions under PLAN-04. Date input must use the agreed bounds and conversion contract; no additional time precision is inferred.
stories.sameDateOrderingDecision: DEC-14 resolved: new/redated event last in destination group; preserve others’ relative/manual order and same-date edit position.

stories.title: Manually arrange timeline events sharing a date

Capture the ordering interaction under PLAN-04. Inherit the existing TECH-01/02/04/05/11 storage, identity, publication and writer contracts.
stories.sameDateOrderingDecision: DEC-14 resolved: new/redated event last in destination group; preserve others’ relative/manual order and same-date edit position.

stories.title: Revise a populated calendar without changing elapsed chronology

Use TECH-01's common chronology contract and TECH-02/04/05's consistent publication, writer serialization and operation-recovery guarantees; inherit relevant TECH-11 persistence verification. Capture populated-calendar editing interactions under PLAN-04.

stories.storageAmendment: Plain-text chapter-id.wrt with chapter details/formatting in matching chapter-id.json; save, history, restore, backup and export keep versions matched with coordinated catalog publication.
stories.navigationDecision: DEC-15: automatic matched-version save before leaving; warning, retained writing and pending navigation with retry/cancel if save fails.

stories.dateRangeDecision: DEC-01 resolved: end=start for inverted valid pair, otherwise independent optional bounds; linked events unchanged.
stories.chapterTieDecision: DEC-16 resolved: saved creation order within same-start group; missing starts first; other dates chronological.

stories.title: Automatically save current work at a configurable interval

stories.autosaveDecision: DEC-17: timer starts on open/restarts on interval change; one overdue resume save; no overlap; warning/retained edits on failure with next-interval retry and Retry now.

stories.title: Choose light, dark or system application appearance
stories.requirements: FR-30 appearance behavior and persistence; CAP-12; AD-3/11/18 and settings convention; NFR-1/2/3/7/9. FR-28/29 import/export will round-trip this selected mode in a later Epic 2 story.

stories.title: Configure independent saving and recovery settings

stories.settingsValidationDecision: DEC-07 resolved: positive whole-minute intervals/whole-day retention; missing=current, unknown=warn/ignore, invalid known=reject whole import; unavailable backup folder allowed.

stories.guidedPromptDecision: DEC-05 resolved: exact seven existing-field prompts recorded in Story 3.2 and canonical contracts; no new fields or expectations.

stories.profileImageDecision: DEC-18 resolved: PNG/JPEG/WebP readable-content validation; unchanged managed copy; preserve aspect ratio, no crop/stretch; failed import retains prior image.

stories.birthPrecisionDecision: DEC-19 accepted: year edits preserve valid recorded month/day; unavailable combination falls back to first month/day of target year, preserving event UUID.
stories.birthClearingDecision: Accepted: resolve affected links before active birth/current association removal; preserve retained history/dependencies.
stories.birthSynchronizationDecision: DEC-19 resolved: direct birth-date edits update profile year; after calendar reconfiguration display year containing preserved birth position without shifting event to day 1.

Resolve DEC-20 before integrating structured events with guided background completeness. Reuse TECH-01's event/character/reference schemas and applicable TECH-02/04/05/11 publication, writer, recovery and storage guarantees. Capture the background/event-entry interactions under PLAN-04. TECH-08 remains a gate before future shared-record deletion or unlinking semantics.
stories.backgroundCompletenessDecision: DEC-20 resolved: narrative answer OR one+ linked background event OR explicit waiver satisfies expected background; none/last removal means incomplete unless waived, drafts save; existing expected matrix unchanged.

stories.addedFactionFieldDecision: DEC-37 resolved: exact/estimate/range/unknown population; resources/culture free text; optional names-and-notes worlds/cities; added fields optional and excluded from completeness.
stories.profileImageDecision: DEC-18 resolved: PNG/JPEG/WebP readable-content validation; unchanged managed copy; preserve aspect ratio, no crop/stretch; failed import retains prior image.

stories.militaryRosterValidationDecision: DEC-21 resolved: partial entries save, empty rows ignored, free-text name/role/description; non-negative decimal strength/movement; signed decimal modifiers; blank unset, invalid field errors, no completeness effect.

DEC-14 timeline-event placement is not a dependency of character-sheet affiliation history.
stories.affiliationHistoryDecision: DEC-22 resolved: fictional-date order, editable same-date sequence/new entries last; final change determines current faction; backdating/correction recalculates chain preserving other choices and retained history; character sheet only.

stories.writingTargetDecision: DEC-23 resolved: optional chapter-count target per story, per-chapter word default 2500; both clearable, blank unset/zero distinct, non-negative whole numbers, invalid field errors; no creation/writing/save cap.
